changes_made.explanation: Added additional datasets and models mentioned in the paper. Normalized inconsistent output descriptions to 'Hindi-English code-switched text' and added 'Controllable code-switched generation' to capture the core contribution.

Normalized metric variations to base forms. Removed 'verbatim copy' and 'source BLEU' as they are not standard metrics but rather analyses using BLEU. Added 'F1 score' used for sentiment analysis evaluation.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses human evaluations and traditional automatic metrics.

guideline: Raters evaluated naturalness of code-switched sentences on a 3-point scale (Very natural, Somewhat natural, Not at all natural)

overall_notes: The paper presents COCOA, a controllable code-switched generation model for Hindi-English. It uses both automatic metrics (BLEU, CMI/SPI metrics, perplexity, F1) and human evaluations (naturalness, semantic consistency, formality). The extraction was generally accurate but missed some secondary datasets and models mentioned throughout the paper.
